$comment: Nocturne pre-render config for mermaid-cli (mmdc). Produces dark-theme static SVG matching nocturne.css tokens (Nocturne is dark-first). Usage: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg --configFile mermaid-config.json --backgroundColor transparent. Pre-rendered SVG is single-theme by nature — pin its figure to the dark ground (#0E1015) so it stays readable if the page is viewed light. Keep in sync with the default token block in nocturne.css.
fontFamily: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
